name: myst-dev-kit
description: Team dev kit: 30 skills - engineering/productivity (spec, TDD, triage, debugging, grilling...) plus the team process rules as on-demand skills (review-and-submit, changelist-verification, pre-implementation-gate...), sync-build-submit + package commands, and the Submit-Audit warning bridge. The two reviewer agents ship as Markdown (inert here); run setup-devkit.ps1 to generate them as ~/.codex/agents/*.toml with sandbox_mode read-only, or review INLINE via the review-changes skill (review-and-submit's no-subagent path). See docs/tool-capability-matrix.md.

interface.shortDescription: Myst team skills, review workflows, and Submit-Audit warning
